modelValue.zh-CN: 受控值，使用 v-model 绑定；形态同 defaultValue。传 undefined 视为非受控，从受控变回 undefined 时显示回到 defaultValue。ColorValue 按不可变值对待，更新时整体替换。
modelValue.en-US: Controlled value, bound with v-model; same shape as defaultValue. undefined means uncontrolled, and going back to undefined from a controlled value shows defaultValue again. Treat ColorValue as immutable and replace it as a whole.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 非受控的初始值，是同时包含 hsva、hex、rgba 三种格式的对象，默认对应 #39c5bb。
defaultValue.en-US: Initial value when uncontrolled, an object holding hsva, hex and rgba; defaults to the color object of #39c5bb.

eyeDropper.zh-CN: 是否开启滴管拾色器，需要安全 context 与 Chromium 95 以上。
eyeDropper.en-US: Whether to enable the eyedropper color picker; requires a secure context and Chromium 95 or later.

defaultFormat.zh-CN: 手动输入时默认使用的颜色格式，可选 rgba、hex、hsva。
defaultFormat.en-US: Color format used by default for manual input: rgba, hex or hsva.

usePopover.zh-CN: 是否放入 Popover 渲染，触发器使用默认插槽。
usePopover.en-US: Whether to render inside a Popover; the trigger comes from the default slot.

popoverProps.zh-CN: 放入 Popover 时传给 Popover 的属性与监听器（onVisibleChange 等）；class、style 替代 className、style。弹层默认以 click 触发、role 为 dialog，默认名称取语言包，ariaLabel、ariaLabelledby 优先。
popoverProps.en-US: Props and listeners (such as onVisibleChange) passed to the Popover when usePopover is on; class and style replace className and style. The popup opens on click with role dialog by default and takes its default name from the locale; ariaLabel and ariaLabelledby take precedence.

update:modelValue.zh-CN: 用户选中颜色时触发，载荷为 ColorValue，供 v-model 回写。
update:modelValue.en-US: Emitted when the user picks a color, with a ColorValue payload, for v-model to write back.

change.zh-CN: 用户选中颜色时触发，载荷为 ColorValue；picker 内部输入框冒泡的原生 change 不会到达该事件。
change.en-US: Emitted when the user picks a color, with a ColorValue payload; native change events bubbling from the inner inputs do not reach it.

default.zh-CN: usePopover 时的触发器，默认是一个色块按钮；不使用 Popover 时不渲染。
default.en-US: The trigger when usePopover is on, a color swatch button by default; not rendered otherwise.

topSlot.en-US: Renders extra elements at the top.

bottomSlot.en-US: Renders extra elements at the bottom.

root.zh-CN: picker 根元素；usePopover 时位于弹层内，弹层关闭时为 null。
root.en-US: The picker root element; inside the popup when usePopover is on, so null while the popup is closed.
